subject.title: feat(agents): add scoped command prompt projection

question: Should OpenClaw make command inventory part of ordinary agent prompts and adopt the new plugin CLI descriptor metadata as a permanent public contract?
rationale: This changes default model behavior and public plugin API surface; repository tests cannot determine whether those are intended product contracts.

options.title: Land a narrowed projection
options.body: Require explicit caller opt-in, wire the intended specialized scope, harden dynamic encoding, and add real-run proof before merge.

options.title: Keep the renderer experimental
options.body: Retain an internal caller-owned renderer without changing default prompts or public plugin API yet.

options.title: Pause behind the foundation
options.body: Defer this draft until the command inventory RFC and prerequisite PRs are accepted.

recommendation.title: Land a narrowed projection
recommendation.body: Require explicit caller opt-in, wire the intended specialized scope, harden dynamic encoding, and add real-run proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history connects this owner most directly to both embedded prompt assembly and the existing plugin CLI descriptor boundary.
